hello.speaker: kaelen
hello.text: You have the look of someone about to do something dangerous. Kaelen Ashford. I guard caravans, when there are caravans.

choices.text: I am going into the Barrow. I could use a shield arm.

story.speaker: kaelen
story.text: The east road is closed and the merchants have gone home. A sword that is not earning is just a heavy stick.

choices.text: Then earn with me. The Reeve is paying to quiet the Barrow.

offer.speaker: kaelen
offer.text: The Barrow. Of course it is the Barrow. What is the split?

choices.text: Hollowmere needs you more than your purse does.

join.speaker: kaelen
join.text: Equal shares, then. You have my sword.

join_glad.speaker: kaelen
join_glad.text: ...It does, does it not. All right. For the town. But I still want my share.
